children: The insurance industry veteran brings over 25 years of experience as the CDSL subsidiary looks to expand its repository business and deepen partnerships with insurers

Centrico Insurance Repository Limited (CIRL), a subsidiary of Central Depository Services (India) Limited (CDSL), has appointed Ashish Sardesai as its Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, effective 2 November 2026. The appointment comes as the company looks to strengthen its position in the insurance repository segment, expand its industry partnerships and enhance the digital services available to policyholders.

Sardesai brings more than 25 years of professional experience across life insurance, financial services, business development and technology-led enterprises. Over the course of his career, he has held senior leadership positions at several organisations in the insurance and financial services sectors, including Edelweiss Tokio Life Insurance, Tata AIA Life Insurance, Max New York Life Insurance and AIBCL (India) Insurance Broking. His experience spans business strategy, institutional partnerships, market development and building business operations across different segments of the financial services industry.

In addition to his experience in the insurance sector, Sardesai has founded and led an AI-powered skill-tech platform, giving him exposure to technology-led business models and digital enterprise development. His professional background combines insurance industry knowledge with experience in business development and technology-driven initiatives.

His appointment comes at a time when CIRL's insurance repository operations are expanding. As of 30 September 2026, the company had approximately 26.10 lakh electronic insurance accounts and partnerships with 49 insurance companies. The growing account base and insurer network reflect the increasing adoption of electronic insurance records and the industry's gradual shift towards digital policy management.

Insurance repositories enable policyholders to maintain their insurance policies in electronic form, reducing dependence on physical documents and making policy information easier to access and manage. Through its repository services, CIRL works with insurers to facilitate the electronic holding of insurance policies and improve the overall policyholder experience.

Sardesai's appointment is expected to strengthen the company's leadership as it focuses on expanding its repository business, building relationships across the insurance ecosystem and improving the delivery of digital insurance services.
